newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Varazdinska Banka signes deal with EBRD.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Varazdinska Banka signes deal with EBRD.

text.p: Croatian Varazdinska Banka agreed a 20 million German marks loan with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), local newspapers reported on Wednesday.
Vecernji List daily quoted finance ministry official Ivica Smiljan saying the loan would increase competition on Croatian financial markets and help reduce interest rates.
The sub-loans would be extended to companies and small entrepreneurs for a seven-year period at rates lower than the current ones.
The EBRD will also buy 1,000 shares from the bank's portfolio, representing a 10 percent stake. Varazdinska last month put the value of the deal at 3.2 million marks.

Experts from both banks agreed to a development plan for the next seven years including opening Varazdinska Banka branches in Zagreb, Rijeka, Split and Osijek, Vecernji list said. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
